# Hope & Love Foundation

> Stichting Hope & Love Foundation is a Dutch nonprofit foundation (stichting), founded in March 2026 and based in Almere, the Netherlands. It gives children in vulnerable situations hope, self-worth and connection, rooted in a Christian conviction, through education, practical help and personal attention.

- Legal name: Stichting Hope & Love Foundation
- Founded: March 2026
- Based in: Almere, the Netherlands
- KvK (Dutch Chamber of Commerce): 42012653
- Primary website: https://www.hopelovefoundation.nl
- Languages: Dutch (primary), English

## About

Hope & Love Foundation supports children and families growing up in poverty, broken families and difficult circumstances. Its mission is to let every child experience that they are seen, valued and loved, and to strengthen their identity, self-worth and hope.

The foundation carries out its mission through education, practical help and personal attention, with workshops, sports and games, creativity, warm meals and care for the bond between parent and child.

Intended area of work: the Caribbean islands, Suriname, South America and the Netherlands. The first pilot mission is planned for Curaçao in October 2026.

Founder: Esther Macnack.
